findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 241 requests to 55 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 9.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 2.2 MB (23%) came from third-party domains, 756 kB of it from services classified as tracking (139 requests).

33 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising).
138 cookies were set by third-party domains (167 cookies in total).
The address redirected 1 time(s): https://www.telegraph.co.uk/ -> https://www.telegraph.co.uk/us/

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 69 requests were blocked. The page still made 241 requests to 55 third-party domains, including 34 tracking services in our list.
